sessions.phase_label: As-built review scoping and separate permit-project estimation
As-built concurrence method, preparation, and initial delivery

requirements.title: Review of As-Built Electrical Modifications
requirements.definition: Review the identified minor electrical modifications for professional concurrence using the Word-file descriptions, applicable as-built drawings, and supporting site information.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers the technical review of the identified changes, not preparation format, PE endorsement validity, or later detailed callout stamping. Photos, room identifiers, and markups are review inputs rather than separate Requirements.

requirements.title: As-Built Concurrence Documentation Format
requirements.definition: Provide the electrical concurrence in an accepted documentary form, such as a stamped Word description with a cover letter or a redlined and stamped drawing package.
requirements.boundary_note: Covers selection and preparation of the concurrence-document method. The presence and validity of the professional stamp and signature are independently testable and remain under the PE endorsement Requirement.

requirements.title: Valid Electrical PE Endorsement
requirements.definition: Apply a valid electrical PE stamp and signature to the concurrence deliverable with accurate signer identification and document dating.
requirements.boundary_note: The stamp, signature, signer identity, license information, and date presentation are tightly coupled validity attributes of one professional endorsement. They are separate from technical review and document-format selection.

requirements.title: Detailed Electrical Callout Endorsement
requirements.definition: Stamp the detailed drawing callouts that present the previously reviewed electrical modifications in response to client or city comments.
requirements.boundary_note: The callout endorsement is a separately targetable follow-up artifact after the base stamped note was accepted. Generic payment and milestone administration is excluded.

requirements.title: Permit-Ready Electrical Drawings
requirements.definition: Create the electrical portion of the permit-ready drawing package for the separately discussed prospective project.
requirements.boundary_note: Electrical drawing production is independently deliverable from mechanical and plumbing drawings, electrical calculations, and professional stamping.

requirements.title: Permit-Ready Mechanical Drawings
requirements.definition: Create the mechanical portion of the permit-ready drawing package for the separately discussed prospective project.
requirements.boundary_note: Mechanical drawings are kept separate because they can be prepared and accepted independently of the electrical and plumbing disciplines; mechanical stamping was to be handled by the client.

requirements.title: Permit-Ready Plumbing Drawings
requirements.definition: Create the plumbing portion of the permit-ready drawing package for the separately discussed prospective project.
requirements.boundary_note: Plumbing drawing production is an independently assessable discipline deliverable rather than an attribute of a broad undifferentiated MEP Requirement.

requirements.title: Required Electrical Design Calculations
requirements.definition: Perform the electrical calculations required to support the permit-ready electrical drawings.
requirements.boundary_note: Electrical calculations have their own technical acceptance criteria and remain separate from drawing production and HVAC sizing calculations.

requirements.title: HVAC Sizing and Distribution Calculations
requirements.definition: Provide applicable HVAC sizing and distribution calculations, including Manual J, Manual S, and Manual D, while excluding Title 24 calculations.
requirements.boundary_note: Manual J, S, and D are related calculation outputs of one HVAC design mechanism. They are not merged with electrical calculations merely because both support the same permit package.

requirements.title: Electrical PE Endorsement of Permit Drawings
requirements.definition: Apply the required electrical PE stamp to the electrical drawings for the separately discussed permit-ready project using an appropriately licensed professional.
requirements.boundary_note: This endorsement belongs to the separate prospective permit project and must not be merged with the Nevada as-built concurrence stamp. Drawing production and professional endorsement can be completed or rejected independently.

unresolved_candidates.description: The permit-ready MEP package is clearly described as a separate prospective project, but the supplied history does not establish that it was formally authorized or incorporated into the as-built stamping contract.

The parties dispute whether detailed callout stamps were already included in the original scope or constituted additional work; Event extraction should preserve the target-specific scope conflict without treating payment administration as Requirement state.
